title: Measures of Information Reflect Memorization Patterns

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the extractability of gender information from the model's internal representations using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) probe and comparing it with information-theoretic measures (intra-neuron entropy and inter-neuron mutual information) on the Bias-in-Bios dataset.

Measuring model reliance on spurious background/environmental contexts using the NICO++ dataset by comparing the entropy and mutual information of neural activations in models trained on context-balanced versus context-unbalanced image sets.
